changes.before: In Calendar on Mac, choose File > New Holiday Calendar. Use the Region menu to select the desired country or region, then click Add. Check the new calendar in the list and inspect a known holiday date in that region.
changes.after: In Calendar on Mac, choose File > New Holiday Calendar. Use the Region menu to select the desired country or region, then click Add. Choose the calendar name, location, alert and refresh settings, then click OK. Check the new calendar in the list and inspect a known holiday date in that region.

changes.after: Apple separately documents Calendar > Settings > Accounts > Delegation for viewing accounts available to you. A CalDAV account appears in Accounts I can access. Have the substitute check the intended account rather than treating an email or familiar event title as proof. Select Show to display the delegated account’s calendars in the main Calendar window.
